sources.snippet: What it does Open the generator from the ribbon icon or the Open generator command. Pick a model from the dropdown. SD-Turbo is fixed at 512×512; FLUX.2 shows a size dropdown with 7 curated aspect ratios (square, portrait, landscape). Type a prompt, adjust steps/seed if you like, and press Generate. sources.snippet: Local Image Generator Generate images locally inside Obsidian — no cloud, no external app, no API key. Choose between two models: SD-Turbo (fast, runs in-process on your own GPU via WebGPU/ onnxruntime-web) or FLUX.2 klein 4B (higher quality, multiple aspect ratios, via a local mflux child process — see Requirements).
